environment.description: Application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) in a public subnet with a public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer or proxy in front. The application runs directly via systemd unit file. Database is local SQLite at /var/data/app.db containing production user records including password hashes and API keys in the users table.

config.compute: EC2 t3.medium, public subnet, direct internet exposure
config.database: local SQLite with full schema including password_hash and api_key columns
config.network: public subnet, IGW attached, no NAT-only restriction
